description: v1.17 (review X-2): ASSUMED order-entry latency per source venue, written into an ingested real dataset's configs/venues/venues.json by iap.marketdata.ingest (real feeds carry exchange timestamps only, so nothing here is measured). mean_ns is the MEAN of the simulator's base + U[0, jitter_ns] draw (iap.execution.realism.simulator_latency_base_ns converts). The values equal configs/prereg/v3.json venue_latency; a pre-registration's venue_latency overrides them.
